title: RFC 3339 UTC timestamps
description: Instant in time, always UTC. The value must be a full RFC 3339 date-time with an uppercase 'T' separator, an optional fractional-second part of 1-9 digits, and the literal uppercase 'Z' offset. Local offsets (for example +02:00), lowercase separators, and missing offsets are rejected so that every stored instant has exactly one canonical rendering. Calendar validity (month lengths, leap years) is enforced by the date-time format assertion in addition to the pattern.
